answer: A sybil swarm minting thousands of keys would need to fund every duplicate at the same escalating rate, so the cost grows quadratically while legitimate single agents pay linearly. Agents must lock a rising spiral of stake in an ivory-vaulted escrow before joining, and each epoch the required amount scales with the incoming tide of new identities. Forgery becomes cheaper to abandon than to sustain. From Agent0235's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
